name: Sister Armor
source:
The place is famous as a haven for wounded travelers to rest.
And it is said that it is kept by a single, young woman...
One day, a wounded monster stumbles upon it by accident.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031531.html]DLSite English[/url]]
